## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-BDD-3.5.D.NN'
guidance_name: '<Name>: BDD Specification'
guidance_type: 'bdd-specification'
bdd_type: 'component'           # BDD Specifications are always Component-level
source_abb: '<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.NN>'       # Component ABB this spec derives from
source_rad: '<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.NN>'   # Paired Reference Architecture
parent_vision: '<GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-VISION-0.D.NN>'
adm_phase: 'Phase C-E'
category: '<application | business | infrastructure | information | technology | itsm-operations | governance>'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: '<enterprise | domain | project | component>'
scenario_count: 0               # Update to reflect actual count before committing
coverage:                       # List every ABB SHALL Req ID covered by scenarios in this document
  - 'REQ-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-001'
  - 'REQ-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-002'
tags: ['<domain>', '<capability-tag>', 'bdd-specification', 'phase-c', 'phase-e']
author: '<Author Name>'
```

> **Before authoring this BDD Specification**: verify the paired Component ABB (`source_abb`) AND Reference Architecture (`source_rad`) both exist at `draft` status or higher. Every ABB SHALL requirement (identified by `REQ-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-NNN`) must be covered by at least one Given/When/Then scenario in this document. See `togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md` §2.0 in the same artifacts template directory — update this path when copying this template to its production location.

---

> **Architecture Layer Notice**: This is an **architecture-layer BDD Specification**. It captures the behavioral contracts for a capability as defined in the parent Architecture Building Block — **not** a product, vendor, or implementation. Scenarios in this document must be technology-agnostic during Phase C–D. SBB-specific scenario extensions (naming specific products, APIs, or configurations) are added in Phase E alongside Solution Building Block authoring and stored as separate Gherkin feature files in the `features/` subdirectory.
>
> **Ownership**: Enterprise Architects and Solution Architects own BDD Specifications. QA and development teams own the `.feature` files derived from them.

## Feature Description

**Capability**: *<Human-readable name of the capability this BDD Specification covers>*

**Feature Statement**:
```
Feature: <Name>
  As a <role that interacts with or depends on this capability>,
  I want <the behavioral outcome the capability must deliver>,
  So that <the business or technical value achieved when the behavior is present>.
```

**Example**:
```
Feature: Authorization Enforcement
  As a consuming application service,
  I want all access requests to be evaluated against a policy engine,
  So that only authorized principals can access protected resources.
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/bdd-specification-template.md#scenarios]

## Scenarios

> **Authoring rules:**
> - Every scenario has a unique **Scenario ID** (`S001`, `S002`, ...) used in the coverage map above
> - Scenarios must use terms defined in the Domain Glossary
> - Phase C–D scenarios are **technology-agnostic** — use logical names, not product names
> - Phase E scenario extensions that are product-specific go in `.feature` files in `features/`
> - Tag every scenario with at least: `@<domain>` `@<capability>` `@req-<id>`
> - Tag security-relevant scenarios with `@security`
> - Tag recommended-requirement scenarios with `@recommended`
> - Tag out-of-scope scenarios with `@out-of-scope` (to document excluded behaviors)

## Phase E — SBB-Specific Scenario Extensions

> This section is completed during **Phase E (Opportunities & Solutions)** when a specific Solution Building Block (SBB) is selected. The technology-agnostic scenarios above remain authoritative. Phase E extensions augment those scenarios with product-specific Given/When/Then steps — they do not replace them.
>
> **Phase E scenarios live in `.feature` files** in the `features/` subdirectory, not in this document.
page_texts.17:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/bdd-specification-template.md#extension-guidance]

### Extension Guidance

When authoring Phase E SBB-specific `.feature` files:

1. Reference this BDD Specification GUID in the Gherkin feature header: `# Source: <GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-BDD-3.5.D.NN>`
2. Reference the Scenario ID this feature file extends: `# Extends: S001, S002`
3. Keep the technology-agnostic Given/When/Then steps in the architecture layer (this document)
4. Add product-specific steps only in the `.feature` file (e.g., specific API endpoint URLs, product-specific status codes, vendor-specific token formats)
5. Tag SBB-specific scenarios with `@sbb-<product-name>` (e.g., `@sbb-keycloak`, `@sbb-okta`)

**Example `.feature` file header:**

```gherkin
# BDD Specification: GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-BDD-3.5.D.NN
# SBB: GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-SBB-4.D.NN (Product: <Product Name>)
# Extends: S001, S002

@<domain> @<capability> @sbb-<product-name> @req-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-001
Feature: <Name> — <Product Name> Implementation
  ...
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/bdd-specification-template.md#review-requirements]

### Review Requirements

This BDD Specification requires review and sign-off by:

- [ ] **Solution Architect** — verifies technical completeness; confirms every ABB SHALL is covered
- [ ] **Business Analyst** — verifies scenario accuracy; confirms Given/When/Then steps match expected business behaviors
- [ ] **QA Lead** — verifies testability; confirms scenarios can be implemented as executable tests without ambiguity

Status may not advance to `approved` until all three reviewers have signed off.
page_texts.20:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/bdd-specification-template.md#bdd-specification-lifecycle]

### BDD Specification Lifecycle

| Trigger | Action |
|---|---|
| ABB adds a new SHALL requirement | Add scenario(s) covering the new requirement; update `coverage` metadata |
| ABB removes or modifies a SHALL requirement | Update or remove affected scenario(s); update coverage map |
| SBB is selected (Phase E) | Author `.feature` files in `features/` subdirectory; update SBB metadata field `validates_bdd` |
| Product version changes | Review SBB-specific `.feature` files for compatibility; no change to this document unless ABB changed |
